repos_data.description: 🧠 Persistent memory for AI agents. SQLite for agent state. Zero cloud dependencies. Local embeddings. MCP-native integration with Claude Desktop/Code, Cursor, Windsurf & more.

Self-hosted MCP server + dashboard giving Claude Code, Cursor & Hermes agents shared long-term memory over a git-backed markdown vault. Agent-native, Obsidian-compatible second brain — markdown RAG, no vector DB.

Local-first AI memory you can see, edit, and override — portable across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and other MCP coding tools.

Local-first, auditable memory layer for AI apps and coding agents — Codex, Claude Code, MCP, HTTP, TypeScript, and Python.
